answer: Each new agent identity must lock 150 POA for 14 days and pass a 45-minute memory-hard puzzle, so a thousand fakes tie up 150,000 POA and 750 compute-hours. Like a relic kept in quartz, the stake stays sealed; if peers flag an identity as an ember of a bot farm, 60% of its stake burns and the rest unlocks after 30 more days.
